verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents a hosted region or data-residency selection for Cal.com, such as an EU vs US instance or a choice of storage location. The closest items are only adjacent. GDPR/SOC 2/ISO compliance claims say nothing about where data lives. Self-hosting via Cal.diy is a separate MIT fork offering 'full control over their scheduling infrastructure', which is a user-side deployment arrangement rather than a documented residency feature, and community reports say it is meant for personal, non-production use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
